name: Deskree
description_en:
Deskree is a product in the Team collaboration category. Its directory profile covers Discussion Boards, Chat (Messaging), Brainstorming, Task Management, Project Management, Document Management.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Freelancers Individuals. API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $19.99. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: exchange messages within the supported workspace; create, assign and track units of work; coordinate project tasks, responsibilities and progress; organize documents and control their access and revisions. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
Deskree 属于团队协作软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括讨论区、聊天消息、头脑风暴、任务管理、项目管理、文档管理。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 自由职业者 个人用户。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $19.99. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在受支持的工作空间中交换消息；创建、分配并跟踪具体工作任务；协调项目任务、负责人和进度；整理文档并管理访问权限与版本。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
